metaDescription: Meet Kristen Aing: enterprise cybersecurity sales, seller coaching and practical building, guided by curiosity, clear decisions and helping people move forward.
headline: Strategist. Leader. Builder.
lead: I'm Kristen Aing. My work connects enterprise cybersecurity sales, people development, and practical building. I want to help people see what's possible and give them the clarity, confidence, and tools to move forward.

Curious by nature. Builder by instinct. I studied advertising and business foundations at The University of Texas at Austin. Advertising taught me to make complex ideas clear. Enterprise cybersecurity sales taught me to connect that story to technical evidence and a buying decision.

principles.name: People first
principles.body: I listen, coach and share context so a teammate can succeed without depending on one person for every answer.

principles.name: Problem-driven
principles.body: I begin with customer or team friction, test assumptions and identify what would actually help before suggesting a tool.

principles.name: Systems-minded
principles.body: I document repeatable processes, define ownership and build small workflows that others can improve.

leadershipApproach: My approach to leadership combines accountability with curiosity: clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, evidence-based decisions and room for people to develop their own strengths.
approachIntro: Enterprise selling sits at the center. Through coaching, clearer buying decisions and practical systems, I work to reduce unnecessary friction for buyers, builders and teammates. Explore the evidence behind each part of that approach.
careerIntro: My path has moved from advertising and channel GTM into enterprise cybersecurity sales, team coaching, and practical systems building. The experience timeline highlights the organizations and kinds of work that shaped that path.
education: B.S. Advertising, Business Foundations. The University of Texas at Austin.
MBA, IT Management. Western Governors University, in progress.
AWS Cloud Practitioner and AI Practitioner, foundational.
practiceIntro: Start with a workflow. Explore the approach, open the supporting tools, then follow the evidence, from enterprise selling and team development to independent building.
